name: io.github.Servosity/cisco-meraki-mcp
title: Cisco Meraki MCP
description: Meraki Dashboard for MSPs: every API operation plus cross-org outages, renewals, and changes

environmentVariables.name: MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Meraki Dashboard API key (Dashboard > My profile > API access); reaches every org its admin can see.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Regional dashboard API URL, e.g. https://api.meraki.ca/api/v1. Leave blank for https://api.meraki.com/api/v1.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_MERAKI_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every write from the MCP server (GET only; fleet push --apply refused).

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_MERAKI_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Meraki requests.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_MERAKI_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.
